{"evidence":[{"sentence_id":0,"text":"Superman: Tower of Power is a drop tower ride currently located at three Six Flags parks, and a former installment at Kentucky Kingdom.","title":"Superman: Tower of Power"},{"sentence_id":0,"text":"The Kellogg Company (also Kellogg's, Kellogg, and Kellogg's of Battle Creek) is an American multinational food manufacturing company headquartered in Battle Creek, Michigan, United States.","title":"Kellogg's"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" Kellogg's produces cereal and convenience foods, including cookies, crackers, toaster pastries, cereal bars, fruit-flavored snacks, frozen waffles, and vegetarian foods.","title":"Kellogg's"},{"sentence_id":2,"text":" The company's brands include Froot Loops, Apple Jacks, Corn Flakes, Frosted Flakes, Rice Krispies, Special K, Cocoa Krispies, Keebler, Pringles, Pop-Tarts, Kashi, Cheez-It, Eggo, Nutri-Grain, Morningstar Farms, and many more.","title":"Kellogg's"},{"sentence_id":3,"text":" Kellogg's stated purpose is \"Nourishing families so they can flourish and thrive.\"","title":"Kellogg's"}],"peer_messages":["Unverified peer answer: 1 Wall Street Court in Manhattan’s Financial District, at the intersection of Wall Street, Pearl Street and Beaver Street.\nEvidence: {\"sentence_id\":0,\"text\":\"1 Wall Street Court in the Financial District of Manhattan, also known as The Beaver Building and The Cocoa Exchange (as the former home of the New York Cocoa Exchange) is a triangular-shaped building reminiscent of the Flatiron Building.\",\"title\":\"1 Wall Street Court\"}\nEvidence: {\"sentence_id\":1,\"text\":\" The building, designed by Clinton and Russell and completed in 1904, is located at the intersection of Wall Street, Pearl Street, and Beaver Street.\",\"title\":\"1 Wall Street Court\"}"],"previous_answer":"Battle Creek, Michigan, United States and Kentucky Kingdom","question":"Where is the Cocoa Krispies and former Superman sponsor located?"}
